convention: T = 1..100 is the state end0[T-1]; Phase 2 = T 11..100 (90 task ends). stoch/p161/p170 use t = T+1. Births at T = pairs lifter at T and not at T-1. Dead target (k_i = 0) => N = -1 in npz, excluded from stats.
criterion: verbatim bridges_at from stoch_bridges.py (P158/P161/P176 loose criterion); smooth gate tau = 0.1 sd(z) + 1e-12; T_i = top-3 of K_n * dd/dz; need = (k_i+1)//2

strat.note: independent permutation of each candidate's series within 4 quantile strata of the target's width k_i(T) over its alive Phase-2 tasks (keeps each candidate's rate per stratum; destroys same-task pairing within strata)

null_target_shuffle.note: mu_i is not invariant under this null; sd(mu_i) across targets compares target heterogeneity with the cross-sectional draw.
